svg.text: Low-intensity proteins are noisier — limma borrows that trend to steady each protein’s variance.
Same pattern as low-count genes in RNA-seq (DESeq2 dispersion plot).
Every protein is pulled toward the trend; the extremes move most.
⚠️ With few samples, some proteins look very consistent by chance → tiny SE → huge t → a hit that is not real.
💡 trend = TRUE shrinks toward the curve in ①, not toward one global value — the same idea as DESeq2’s dispersion shrinkage.
